The inequalities that define the region $D,$

u=x\,\text{and}\,v=x-y.
$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}Δ & ={(u,v)\,:\,0\le u\le 2,\,0\le v\le 2}.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
